title: eludite.test.results input
description: Read a run's results, as the Test Explorer shows them: each test's outcome and duration and, as its detail pane shows for the selected test, the failure message, the stack trace and what the test wrote. Paged with `max_items` and `cursor`.

run.description: A run's id. Omitted: the last run.

ids.description: Test ids, as eludite.test.discover and eludite.test.results list them (`<project>|<runner id>`).

max_output_chars.description: Each message, stack trace and output is cut at this many characters (default 4000, at most 100000).

max_items.description: The most tests listed (default 100, at most 5000).
